description: Which store-shard test files the Postgres leg (lane server-store-pg) runs [POD-6980, POD-6958 design 2.10].
The leg runs every store-shard file plus beyondStoreShard and Postgres audits, except sqliteOnly and pending. Engine assignments survive cache-shard moves.
sqliteOnly: the file's subject is SQLite itself. Each entry says why. It never runs on Postgres.

pending: the file is meant to run on both engines but does not pass on Postgres yet. A task that makes a file pass on Postgres removes it here; the list is empty when the Postgres store is complete (POD-6994). PODIUM_TEST_STORE_PG_LEG=pending runs only these files, to see which pass now.
Paths are relative to the repository root. src/store/test-store-engines.test.ts and the lean configuration gate check that every entry is a server-shard file and that engine lists do not conflict.
beyondStoreShard: a file outside the store cache shard that also runs on Postgres. Each entry says why; server-test-shards.ts --write retains departing store files here automatically.
